probe1_xor_transform_partial_recovery.setup: 256-byte uniform message, N in {5,10,20,30}, adversary misses exactly one masked fragment but holds K
probe1_xor_transform_partial_recovery.interpretation: A strict subset of fragments reveals most plaintext bytes; the construction is not an AONT.

probe1b_missing_only_key_fragment: masked fragments alone are a one-time-pad encryption of M; no bytes recoverable without K (by construction, not measured)
probe2_note: paper_artifacts/journal_scripts/stochastic_loss.sh draws the channel state independently at every step (state does not depend on the previous state), i.e. i.i.d. Bernoulli loss; stored values are within |z|<2 of (1-p)^20 for all four p values (see z_score).

probe3_monte_carlo_ci.ci_method: Wald normal approximation 1.96*std/sqrt(n); script uses unseeded random()

probe4_latency_csv.generator_script: scripts/gen_v3_latency_compare_csv.py writes constant static=48, agent=35 for every load
